title: Stinkbomb Chocolate Chip Cookies
description: A unique and pungent twist on classic chocolate chip cookies, perfect for adventurous eaters. Be cautious when consuming, as stinkbomb peppers can be overwhelming for some.
instructions: Whisk together the white sugar, brown sugar, and butter until light and fluffy.
Beat in the eggs one at a time.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, baking soda, and salt.
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Stir in the diced stinkbomb peppers and white chocolate chips.
Scoop tablespoon-sized balls of dough onto a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Bake for 10-12 minutes or until the edges are lightly golden.
Remove from the oven and let cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.
